# routeros_zerotier_controller_member (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network` (String) The ZeroTier network identifier the member belongs to.
- `zt_address` (String) The 10 hex digit ZeroTier address (node id) of the member.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `authorized` (Boolean) Whether the member is allowed to join the network.
- `bridge` (Boolean) Whether the member is allowed to act as a bridge, that is, to forward traffic for MAC addresses other than its own.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ip_address` (Set of String) Addresses the controller assigns to this member. They have to fall inside the ranges configured on the controller network.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the member.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean) A flag whether the member is currently inactive.
- `last_seen` (String) Time elapsed since the controller last heard from this member.
